title: Rocket-IM E10C-W1 恢复见证冻结规范
description: FROZEN_SPEC_NOT_IMPLEMENTED：独立规范文件，未接入现有实现、旧 message.schema.json 或 HTTP 路由。依本轮用户授权已在规范层审定采纳 W1 信任/可用性/保守迁移取舍；真实部署信任根/独立控制域仍未验证。JSON Schema 只验形状，原字节、签名、摘要、跨对象绑定、预算、时序、实际 MLS/存储/锚和权限门禁须另作验证。本轮不运行实现测试，不构造缺 update-path 私有 Commit，不重试历史平台阻断。
x-signature-algorithm: Ed25519 (not Ed25519ph); 32-byte non-weak public key, 64-byte signature; strict verification
x-signature-rule: signature = Ed25519.sign(key, UTF8(domain including one terminal NUL byte) || exact decoded statement_bytes). JSON parsing never replaces original bytes. Reject duplicate keys at all depths, invalid UTF-8, BOM, trailing non-whitespace content, missing/extra fields and unknown versions. Different valid UTF-8 JSON encodings are different originals; identical semantic objects do not imply byte-identical retry.

x-version-matrix.current_admission: verified root, legacy recovery (rim-permission-3 + rim-recovery-receipt-1), or W1 recovery (rim-permission-4 + rim-recovery-receipt-2)
x-version-matrix.unknown_version: reject before state mutation; no optional policy, version retry, downgrade or stripping fields

x-storage-contract.mandatory_state: witness_state with authenticated Activation and all policy/request/response/installation associations, including activation before any candidate; Activation.policy_ref may be explicit null to enable fail-closed W1 without an available witness policy
x-storage-contract.outer_relay_schema: existing global/identity-source markers may remain only if the mandatory recovery_schema=2 check is enforced on every load; missing/unknown marker rejects
x-storage-contract.migration: validate in temporary state then commit atomically with existing anchor coordination; failure preserves old state; old programs must reject W1 state
x-storage-contract.legacy_installed: retain original installation facts and exact retry subject to global gates; never synthesize W1 witness
x-storage-contract.legacy_uninstalled_target: preserve old R0 and material occupancy, deny first Welcome install after activation; joined survivors may still process old Commit under old rules; only lawful new attempt can bind P
x-storage-contract.layout_scope: Only outer version 3, mandatory witness_state/activation, exact-original associations and load-time verification are frozen; the complete DeviceState/physical database layout is not frozen by this schema.
x-storage-contract.activation_updates: Policy absence never disables W1. Later binding requires authenticated monotonically greater Activation revision; all old activation originals remain. Intent/candidate/receipt/witness policy references are always non-null.

x-semantic-invariants: P trust is independently established before Intent, never by its own signature or by Service selection. PolicyRef and witness_profile equal across intent/claim/close/allocation/candidate/R0/request/response/install record.
P is immutable for a candidate even after accepted/closed. Directory refs are exact sorted unique A/T/W account union; W is present and qualified in predecessor and successor.
New candidate tuple must be request-2, claim-2, allocation receipt-2, permission-4 and terminal receipt-2. Historic admission references are distinct and do not permit mixed candidate tuples.
R0 binds P but never references later W installation/witness. W processes the exact accepted private Commit from a non-pending actual predecessor, commits installation before signing.
Witness request digest hashes the exact signed request; response context/challenge matches. Neither fresh challenge nor signature proves global freshness or remote execution.
T independently validates actual Welcome, package, all leaf lifetimes and public successor; no claim of full epoch-secret equality with W.

Expiry: intent/candidate use existing 1..300 second bounds; witness request 1..60 seconds and <= package not_after; response <= request expiry, issued_at<=now<expires_at on first use. No clock rollback or deadline refresh on exact retry.
Known verified higher facts/revocation/conflict are observed before first install; cached witness original remains immutable but supplemental authentic facts must be provided.
Only one current active challenge per uninstalled endpoint, at most 16 distinct challenges per candidate; exact retry consumes no new quota. Cancel/replace and Apply serialize.
No implementation/business/security PASS follows from schema or format vectors. Deployment trust roots and real independence remain separate prerequisites.

Activation with explicit null policy_ref enables W1 fail-closed even when no eligible W exists; it never permits a legacy first recovery install. Missing policy_ref is invalid. Subsequent policy binding uses an authorized monotonic activation revision, never modifies old activation/candidate originals.

x-wire-budgets.envelope: actual complete UTF-8 JSON bytes in fixed compact outer order statement_bytes,signature_bytes; no escaped base64; inner raw JSON unchanged
x-wire-budgets.note: maxLength on Base64 is only a preliminary shape bound; enforce exact full envelope wire byte limits before decoding/persisting; attachment transport and existing ledger budgets remain independently bounded

StateRef.description: Rust 探针的公共群检查点摘要：SHA-256(固定域字节 || GroupContext TLS 序列化字节)，输出 64 位小写十六进制。公共结构含协议版本、套件、群标识、epoch、树哈希、已确认 transcript 和扩展；不导出私有状态。

Member.description: 完整设备身份；32 字节强 Ed25519 公钥另作密码核验。不同身份/钥不证明独立控制域。

SourceRef.description: 对准确公开来源原字节的 SHA-256 引用，不是来源授权或诚实性的证明；缺少原件/既有可信授权时不能凭摘要自举信任。安装凭据与附带来源均摘要其保存的完整原字节，不重序列化。

PolicyRef.description: policy_sha256 摘要准确 PolicyBytes：SHA-256(policy 域 || u64be(字节长度) || 原字节)。Policy 正文不包含自身摘要；policy_version 是单调策略修订号，不是协议版本。

Independence.description: 本档位预先指定的 W 本身诚实、钥未失陷且不受 A/T 控制；同主体多设备不增加独立性。来源声明不自动证明实际独立性。

Policy.description: 可信本地固定策略原件，单指定 W、1-of-1；无自签授权。可信分发/变更根与真实控制域仍须独立建立。T 先持久固定此原件，再签目标意图；每个候选即使 accepted/closed 后也不可替换策略。

PolicyEnvelope.description: PolicyBytes 解码后严格解析为 Policy，字段对应与摘要由语义校验器核验；本封装不带签名且不能自行建立策略授权。

AdmissionRef.description: 沿用 admission-record/v1 五部分摘要。必须取得准确被引用 change/receipt 原件并校验其版本对：根仅普通 permission-2+permission-receipt-1；current 可为根、legacy recovery permission-3+recovery-receipt-1 或 W1 permission-4+recovery-receipt-2。缺原件拒绝，不能由摘要猜版本；引用旧入口不等于允许新候选混用旧格式。

DirectoryRef.description: 沿用已验证设备目录原件摘要规则。引用准确目录，不能用裸版本号作新鲜性证明。

DirectoryRefs.description: 恰为 A/T/W 的 account_id 并集，按 ASCII account_id 升序去重；必须逐引用核验准确目录及所需身份/资格。跨字段相等与排序需语义校验。

PermissionCheckpoint.description: 沿既有检查点语义：成员按(account_id,device_id)严格排序、身份/公钥唯一且含群主；state_ref 只是公共 GroupContext 摘要，不证明全部 epoch 秘密相同。

CompleteCheckpoint.description: 群/epoch 与完整权限检查点一并绑定；scope、Commit 前后 epoch、R0 声明和 W 实际结果均须对应。

SignedRecord.description: 签名只验证解码后的准确原声明字节，绝不验证重序列化副本。

Intent.description: signer 必须为 P.target，P.witness 与 A/T 身份及钥均不同；known_floor 等于 predecessor；意图窗口仍为 1—300 秒且只在首次使用边界检查当前有效性。

Claim.description: 批准者签名；policy_ref/profile/范围和准确 Intent 原件摘要全部对应。reason 必须显式 null。

Close.description: T 或 A 按原权限关闭；不能把 accepted 改为 closed，不能换绑定 P。

Statement.description: A 签名的恢复候选；完整 P 与所有 Intent/Claim/Allocation 上下文必须对应。原候选期限不扩大目标意图期限。新包/Welcome/Commit 摘要沿现有 SHA-256(raw bytes)。

Proof.description: statement_bytes 解码为 Statement；签名域严格 permission-change/v4。JSON 形状通过不代表 Commit 是合法 MLS、更不证明实际安装。

Receipt.description: Service 签名；三种回执都绑定同一 P/Intent。accepted 只证明 R0，不包含其后才生成的 W 安装凭据或见证，避免循环依赖。

Bundle.description: 本候选内部必须是 request-2/claim-2/receipt-2/permission-4 的同一 P 链；allocation.result 必须 allocated。策略原件已本地固定，不用不可信随包策略替换。

PublicBundle.description: 供 W/其他幸存者读取；不暴露目标 Welcome 或私有 bundle。

Record.description: receipt.result 必须 accepted；核验候选/分配/原意图摘要及检查点。

PublicRecord.description: 完整公开 R0；accepted_ref 使用本 change 与 receipt 原字节计算 admission-record/v1。

WitnessRequest.description: T 签名；32 字节随机 challenge，窗口 1—60 秒且不晚于新包 not_after。同一 scope/current 只有一个活动 challenge，最多 16 个不同 challenge/候选，替换或取消先持久。引用的是准确 accepted R0，不能把原 current_admission 与该后继混淆。

WitnessResponse.description: 指定 W 签名；准确请求签名原件摘要/全部上下文对应。只可依据非 pending 幸存者路径实际校验精确私有 Commit 并持久 R1 的凭据；不是远程执行证明，不声称 W 解密过 Welcome。response 窗口不得超过原请求；highest_known 的事实须有可核验原件，不证明全局最新。

SignedWitnessRequest.description: 签名封装的实际 UTF-8 wire JSON 字节总数受限；canonical 外层顺序 statement_bytes,signature_bytes，无空白且不转义 Base64。内层原声明不要求 JCS 或规范重排。

SignedWitnessResponse.description: 签名封装的实际 UTF-8 wire JSON 字节总数受限；canonical 外层顺序 statement_bytes,signature_bytes，无空白且不转义 Base64。内层原声明不要求 JCS 或规范重排。

PublicEvidenceAttachment.description: 已知事实的准确公开原件；必须先按既有事实类型/版本/可信来源核验，不能因 source_sha256 一致就信任裸字段。unknown 事实类型/版本不得忽略；引用原件不可得时不能据其放行。

WitnessDelivery.description: response 仍为先保存的原字节。known_evidence 覆盖 response 中全部 known_evidence_refs；补充提供 W 签发后新获知的更高水位/撤销/冲突。T 先核验并观察全部有效事实再判断首次安装；无原件时保持待核验。附件按既有有界公开同步/分段传输，不能作为不受限单包；签名封装 8/16 KiB 不包含附件，但不豁免外层 transport 限额。

Activation.description: 必须先独立确认可信授权，再和本地 version=3/witness_state 原子落盘并纳入锚。policy_ref 必填但可显式 null：仅表示 W1 门禁已启用、尚无可用固定策略，仍拒绝目标首次恢复安装，不回退 legacy；缺少 W 的 A/T 群也能先启用保护。后续只能经可信授权追加更高 activation_version 的新原件来绑定/改变 P，保留旧原件与水位；既有候选的 P 永不重绑。服务响应或请求参数不能临时关闭门禁。非 null 策略须与本 scope/target 一致。

InstalledRecord.description: T 与群/R1/材料/challenge/锚关联同一一致性提交；此对象为关联规范，不是完整 DeviceState，也不以布尔字段代替真实安装和存储验证。精确已装重试先遵守原操作全局门禁，再可返回历史事实。

InstallationFact.description: W 与真实 R1 同一提交保存的公开安装事实原件，无签名、无自身 hash、不含私钥/provider/群秘密；installation_ref.source_id 是另行持久关联的本地唯一凭据 ID，source_sha256=SHA-256(准确事实 UTF-8 原字节)。签出响应时核对持久原件和实际状态；此事实不是远程执行证明。

AllocationReceipt.description: Service 签名；三种回执都绑定同一 P/Intent。accepted 只证明 R0，不包含其后才生成的 W 安装凭据或见证，避免循环依赖。

AcceptedReceipt.description: Service 签名；三种回执都绑定同一 P/Intent。accepted 只证明 R0，不包含其后才生成的 W 安装凭据或见证，避免循环依赖。

ClosedReceipt.description: Service 签名；三种回执都绑定同一 P/Intent。accepted 只证明 R0，不包含其后才生成的 W 安装凭据或见证，避免循环依赖。

x-required-activation-format-vectors: positive: explicit null Activation.policy_ref has valid shape and implies active W1 with first recovery install blocked
positive: authorized greater activation_version binds non-null PolicyRef while preserving prior original
negative: missing policy_ref, untrusted binding, same/lower activation_version, legacy fallback, existing candidate P replacement
